audit_actor_needs_school_chk.name: audit_actor_needs_school_chk
audit_actor_needs_school_chk.value: "audit_log"."actor_membership_id" is null or "audit_log"."school_id" is not null

class_enrollments_status_ended_chk.name: class_enrollments_status_ended_chk
class_enrollments_status_ended_chk.value:
"class_enrollments"."status" IN ('active', 'transferred', 'withdrawn')
              AND (
                ("class_enrollments"."status" = 'active' AND "class_enrollments"."ended_at" IS NULL)
                OR
                ("class_enrollments"."status" <> 'active' AND "class_enrollments"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL)
              )

class_enrollments_ended_reason_requires_.name: class_enrollments_ended_reason_requires_end_chk
class_enrollments_ended_reason_requires_.value: "class_enrollments"."ended_reason" IS NULL OR "class_enrollments"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL
